Hello,I'm Prathamesh Iyer.

I'm based in Nagpur, India. I make posters and product ads for brands that want to be noticed.

I'm new to this, and I'd rather say it up front than pretend otherwise. Every piece in this portfolio got my full attention, because there are only eight of them.

psst, keep scrolling

Before design I did B2B sales.

So I always ask: would a stranger act on this?

→

Am I experienced?

Not yet. Obsessive about details? Very.

✓

A brief is half the design.

Tell me who it's for and what they should do next.

*

I spent two and a half years in B2B outbound sales and content writing first. That's where I learned the only question that matters: will a stranger stop and act?

My process starts with questions, not software. Who is this for, and what should they do next? I settle that before I open a design file.

Then I sketch the layout and write the headline and call to action alongside it, so the design and the words work as one. You see a clear first draft, not ten options to sort through.

For your brand, that means fewer revision rounds, work that looks like you from poster to ad, and creative people actually act on.

Mood boards are great.

Mood boards with a deadline are better.

→

If the headline needs a paragraph to explain it,

the headline is the problem.

*

Will I nudge the logo size?

Yes. Probably a few times. Happily.

Six things I do well enough to hang on a wall

Poster and print design

Posters / editorial / admissions

Admission, event and collection posters with a clear order of reading, so the headline, the offer and the next step are obvious from arm's length.

see: AerodynamiksJourneyPink Edit

Social media ads

Ads / square and portrait

Creatives built around one message, one product and one look. Made to stop a thumb mid-scroll and still make sense a second later.

see: Yogurtize flipArmaan

Product and lifestyle visuals

Campaign / fragrance / food

Campaign images and hero shots for fragrance, skincare, fashion and food, with the mood set by colour, props and light.

see: ArmaanYogurtize flip

Short product film

Motion / ten seconds

Looping clips for ads, landing pages and feeds. One product, one camera move, no filler.

see: Golden JazzDr. FranciaOuterwear

Typography and layout

Type / grids / hierarchy

Type-led compositions and clear hierarchy. Oversized serif headlines over paper collage, or bold sans headlines with icon rows.

see: JourneyPink EditAerodynamiks

Copy that fits the design

Headlines / calls to action

Headlines and calls to action written alongside the layout, not pasted in at the end. It comes from my years of writing and selling for B2B teams.
